Hello everyone,
We're excited to unveil our comprehensive Starfall Saga Roadmap and share the complete answers from our 2-year anniversary Q&A session!

On the following URL you'll find the roadmap for the next 3 major patches as well as answers for the 2 year qna we hosted!

== https://aa-classic.com/roadmap ==

From the new Taming proficiency to naval sieges, this roadmap represents our vision for the future of ArcheAge Classic.
Thank you for your continued support and feedback - it's what drives us to keep improving and expanding the game we all love!

* ''The ArcheAge Classic Team''
